newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cenbank sets 6-wk T-bill auction for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Czech cenbank sets 6-wk T-bill auction for Wed.

text.p: The Czech National Bank on Tuesday set an auction offering three billion crowns in six-week Finance Ministry treasury bills for Wedenesday.
The CNB said maximum accepted net yield on bids has been set at 12.35 percent in the American auction which closes at 1200 local time (1100 gmt) on Wednesday.

By comparison with the deposit market, average one-month money on Tuesday was trading at 12.40 percent according to the Prague Interbank Bid rate (PRIBID), with two-month PRIBID money at 12.38 percent.
